  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Born Again Concerts presents Shade of Sorrow: Final Rites CRYPTA plus supports from CORPSING and MUST KILL live at Downstairs at the Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Crypta is a Brazilian female Death Metal band, recognized worldwide. Founded in 2019 by Fernanda Lira (bass and vocals) and Luana Dametto (drums), alongside guitarist Tainá Bergamaschi, invited to join the band in 2020, Crypta consolidated its line-up and released, in 2021, the acclaimed debut album “Echoes of the Soul”, released by the Austrian label Napalm Records. The album reached relevant positions in international charts, such as Germany and Switzerland, and drew attention for its sound and visual work.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The second album, “Shades of Sorrow”, released in 2023, reaffirmed the band's prominence on the global scene. In addition to entering significant charts in the US, Europe and Latin America, the album was among the 50 best albums of 2023, according to the São Paulo Association of Art Critics (APCA).</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">With the album, Crypta also debuted on the US Billboard, something rarely achieved by Brazilian metal bands. The band was on 7 charts in the US, 6 in Canada, 2 in England, and also in Switzerland, Germany and Austria.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In 2025, the band were on the road with new tours  in Latin America, Europe, the United States, Canada and Brazil, while preparing their third album, scheduled for release in 2026.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Japanese death metal trio Coffins came into being in 1996 after both a name and a lineup change. Originally formed under the name Compromise You Need and taking its musical cues from <a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/79S80ZWgVhIPMCHuvl6SkA">Swans and </a><a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/0sKlAr34dAjAdb7a9yriqX">Scorn, the</a> group changed its name to Coffins in 1996 and played its first show under the new moniker in December 1997. At the time, Uchino (guitar, vocals) played drums. He moved into position as frontman in 1999 when the band recruited You (drums) to replace him behind the kit. That same year also saw the band shift toward a doom metal sound inspired by <a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/5O7ziOtiFUyRMBJN1J4Tpv">Cathedral and Kyus</a><a href="https://open.spotify.com/artist/3HCpwNmFp2rvjkdjTs4uxs">s. How</a>ever, all of the members were also working with other acts, and Coffins went on hiatus in 2000. The members regrouped in 2003, completed their musical shift into death metal, and brought Sentou aboard as bassist. Their first full-length album, Mortuary in Darkness, was released on the U.S. label Razorback in 2005; in December of the same year, Sentou left Coffins, citing musical differences. He was replaced on bass by Koreeda, who joined a month later and helped Coffins release their second album, The Other Side of Blasphemy, in September 2006. Two years later, Buried Death was released on the 20 Buck Spin label. <br><br>[Source via Spotify, Katherine Fulton, Rovi]</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Formed in 2020 in Dearborn, Michigan, Prostitute is an experimental post-punk and Arab rock band. Born out of the isolation of the COVID-19 lockdown, the band’s debut album, Attempted Martyr, was written in the midst of global and personal turmoil, capturing the zeitgeist of a world unraveling. A loose concept record, it chronicles the rise and fall of a doomed zealot whose pursuit of holy vengeance spirals into a psychotic orgy of violence, greed, and lust.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The band was initially formed by Moe Kazra who enlisted childhood friends Andrew Kaster and Dylan Zaranski, with Ross Babinski and Bret Wall later completing the lineup. Together, they self-funded the album, working with legendary engineer Chris Koltay to shape a sound that's both abrasive and hypnotic—an unrelenting blend of warped guitars, primitive basslines, frenzied drumming, and corrosive synthesizers, interwoven with samples from diverse cultures, ranging from African to Middle Eastern and East Asian influences.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Tracks like “All Hail” (inspired by the 1977 Hanafi Siege of Washington D.C.) immerses listeners in a volatile, hostage-like environment. "Judge" channels Milton's Satan in a chilling rallying cry, while “Body Meat” grapples with religious desperation and the tenuous boundary between faith and madness. Khachab and Kaster’s lyrics have been described by Pitchfork as "disturbingly poetic" with the ability to "lacerate with image alone." Crude sloganeering and scenes of horrific violence are juxtaposed with literary allusion and Islamic symbolism, creating what the band calls a "theatricalization of terrorism." Through this lens, they examine and critique the xenophobic stereotypes targeted at Arabs, distorting them into grotesque caricatures.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Over the past four years, Prostitute has established a reputation for their punishing, high-energy performances. The band’s live shows, described as “dangerous” and “volatile”, finds Moe delivering politically charged sermons atop a deafening bacchanal of sound. In 2023, Prostitute performed at the re-opening of the iconic UFO Bar in Detroit, followed by a series of benefit concerts for Palestine, Lebanon, and Sudan. These performances solidified their growing presence, leading to invites to play at No Rest Fest and New Colossus Festival.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">As Prostitute continues work on their sophomore album, they are delving deeper into electronic and Arabic dance influences, drawing inspiration from the ongoing conflicts in Gaza and Lebanon. Their sound continues to evolve, with new tracks incorporating dabke rhythms, Arabesque melodicism, and industrial synth textures, all while retaining the same anarchic energy that defines their unique sound.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Despite its title, Ratboys’ new album Singin’ to an Empty Chair is not defined by what’s missing. Rather, it’s the beginning of an important dialogue with a close loved one vocalist Julia Steiner finds herself estranged from. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The music on the band’s sixth studio album – its first for New West Records – fills the space that person left behind with 11 songs showcasing Ratboys at the peak of their powers — twangy, effervescent, as confident as they’ve ever been, and perhaps more emotionally interrogative than ever before. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The four-piece Chicago band followed up 2023’s highly acclaimed The Window by reconvening with co-producer Chris Walla to begin tracking at a rural Wisconsin cabin before taking the songs to Steve Albini’s famed Electrical Audio studios in Chicago and later to Rosebud Studio in Evanston, Illinois. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The results veer from bubbly power-pop on “Anywhere” to irresistible post-country on “Penny in the Lake,” along with heart-piercing ballads like “Just Want You to Know the Truth” and an exhilarating detour into the extraterrestrial on “Light Night Mountains All That,” which Steiner dubs the band’s mammoth “wormhole jam.” Singin’ to an Empty Chair also marks the first Ratboys album written since Steiner began therapy, which the singer/lyricist credits for the clarity found across the album’s unflinching examinations of relationship and self. Fittingly, as the album begins by extending a hand into the void, it concludes with a scene of serenity – all while weaving candid honesty, humor, chaos, and whimsy along the way. “It's not all doom and gloom,” Steiner says “The experience of making this record definitely gives me hope for whatever happens next.”</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">A few years back, a collective of four close friends rallied together in a Northport, NY, attic, wrote a bunch of songs, hopped in a renovated school bus, and brought their music right to the people. Attracting a cult following, Arcy Drive’s signature brand of “attic rock” has resonated with fans and tastemakers alike, yielding nearly 100 million cumulative streams, amassing a combined following of 590K-plus on social media, packing endless sold-out shows, and attracting massive co-signs courtesy of Noah Kahan, Marcus Mumford, and more. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The four-piece band—Nick Mateyunas, Austin Jones, Patrick Helrigel, and Brooke Tuozzo—have naturally evolved across a series of independent releases, including the live album Attic Sessions [2022], the Beach Plum EP [2023], and their first full-length offering The Pit [2025]. Emerging as a force of nature on stage, the group impressively sold out their 2025 North American headline run, The Pit Tour Pt. 1, graced the bills of festivals including Bonnaroo, Lollapalooza, and Outside Lands, and even shut down Los Angeles’s Venice Boardwalk with a pop-up show in front of 1k-plus fans. At this year’s Out of the Blue Festival, they hit the stage with Noah Kahan, Mumford, and Caamp—appearing four times in total throughout the day. Between launching The Pit Tour Pt. 2 in the United States and preparing for major festivals, including Governors Ball, Bonnaroo, Borderland, Highwater, Rolling Stone’s Stateside Festival, Austin City Limits, and more, the band now makes their Atlantic Records debut with the release of “one'n a million” and more to come.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Exile Mainstream Records presents LOVE NOISE FREEDOM FESTIVAL&nbsp;&nbsp;live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">On September 19th 2026, the <strong>Love.Noise.Freedom Festival</strong> lands in the UK for the very first time. Love.Noise.Freedom, the beating heart behind every gathering curated by <strong>Exile On Mainstream</strong> has always been a statement. A celebration of heavy music, stubborn independence, and the deep bonds that hold this scene together. And now, that legendary, road-worn, heart-driven vibe finally takes over <strong>Downstairs at the Dome</strong> in <strong>London</strong> for one intense, unifying day.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">This is not a random lineup. This is family.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Might</strong> bring their uncompromising blend of crushing heaviness and raw melody — a band forged in volume and conviction, known for turning every stage into a cathartic release. Their sound balances massive riffs with emotional weight, the kind that lingers long after the amps cool down. Their sound is massive, yes — towering riffs and crushing low end — but beneath the volume lies vulnerability. When they hit, it feels like standing in a storm that somehow holds you upright.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Bulbul</strong>, underground lifers from Austria, have built their legacy the hard way — through decades of stubborn independence and fearless experimentation. Hypnotic, abrasive, uncompromising, they prove that repetition can become ritual, and noise can become transcendence. They are a reminder that art survives because people refuse to let it die.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">&nbsp;With sparse need for words, <strong>Confusion Master</strong> speak through colossal instrumental passages that blur the line between doom, sludge and psychedelic drift. Their music feels like a slow-burning horizon — meditative, heavy, and deeply human. It’s the sound of patience meeting power.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">&nbsp;UK powerhouse <strong>Noisepicker</strong> brings grit, groove and heart. Road-worn, hook-laden and unapologetically loud, they channel the raw pulse of heavy rock ’n’ roll into something immediate and communal. Sweat on the walls. Smiles in the crowd. Riffs that feel like old friends.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">&nbsp;And then there’s <strong>Endure</strong> - a new chapter written by members of Hands Of Omega. Born from experience, loss, growth and persistence, Endure embody an evolving spirit: heavy, honest, and driven by connection.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">&nbsp;Love.Noise.Freedom isn’t about hype. It’s about shared vans, shared stages, shared stories. It’s about a label that built its reputation on loyalty and artistic freedom, finally bringing its community across the Channel. This is about showing up. For the music. For each other. For the idea that independent art still matters — not as nostalgia, but as necessity.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">&nbsp;One day. One stage. One circle of trust. A gathering.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">London, get ready to feel what Exile On Mainstream has always stood for: LOVE. NOISE. FREEDOM.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">We can only move forward when we understand what came before. Havok possess an airtightgrasp on the fundamentals of thrash, enabling them to usher the genre into the fire of the future.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The Colorado quartet lock and load throat-slicing guitars with breakneck rhythms and venomously vitriolic vocals. After piling up tens of millions of streams and earning acclaim from Metal Hammer, Loudwire, Consequence of Sound, and many more, the band ignited their first independent release, the New Eyes EP, in 2024.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Havok have never stopped pushing forward without apology. Thus far, they’ve unleashed a series of fan favorite albums, including Burn [2009], Time Is Up [2011], Unnatural Selection [2013], Conformicide [2017], and V [2020]. The latter represented a critical high watermark with Metal Hammer proclaiming, “Havok have nailed 21st century thrash.”</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Along the way, the group also lit up stages on tour around the world with the likes of Megadeth, Anthrax, Suicidal Tendencies, Testament, Killswitch Engage, Exodus, Sepultura, Kreator, Children Of Bodom, and many more.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Kickstarting this next era with worldwide touring and new music coming in 2026 Havok has enabled itself to move at a prolific pace. In the end, Havok are leveling up and taking thrash with them.</p></div>

TEAM DRESCH is coming to your Town your City your Club your Castle your Squat! It’s been 30 years since we rocked with you in Germany, mountain climbed with you in Switzerland, manic-panicked with you in London. We can’t dang wait to see your beautiful faces again!&nbsp;</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Who the hell is Team Dresch?</strong></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Team Dresch is a band from Portland, Oregon, who started playing together a few years ago, in 1993. Their 1994 album “Personal Best” was recently listed #48 on Rolling Stones “Best 100 Punk Albums of all time”, and they are still touring and making new music. The band is widely regarded as the most influential Queercore band from the US; their sound is a raw nerve angst infused punk grunge vocal harmony layered beautiful angry tender swirling mess of cool AF song dynamics and catchy AF anthems. The raw emotional honesty of their sound was also a formative inspiration for the emo genre. Their live shows are a family reunion; the music is the conduit for the life-affirming connection between the band and audience. Come see them for a group hug joyous mosh pit sing along at the top of your lungs experience like NO OTHER!</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><br></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Action! presents MYRATH plus ROSES OF THIEVES live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Forged between France and Tunisia, Myrath has emerged as one of the most distinctive forces in modern metal. Blending razor-sharp riffs, cinematic orchestrations, and the hypnotic pulse of African, Indian, and European traditions, their music is not a calculated fusion but a natural expression of diverse roots. Fans and critics alike simply call it Blazing Desert Metal.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Myrath’s story is one of resilience. During the Tunisian revolution, the band wrote Tales of the Sands (2011) while protecting their homes by day and composing music by night; a defining moment that still echoes through their sound. Since then, they have conquered international stages from Hellfest to Japan, Europe, and the Americas. In 2022, they made history by performing at the FIFA World Cup in Qatar, reaching millions worldwide.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Their latest release, Karma (2024), marked a rebirth; a bombastic, arena-ready album that reaffirmed their reputation for innovation. Looking ahead, Myrath is preparing their most ambitious project yet: a new album set for 2026, featuring a special duet with Elize Ryd from the band Amaranthe.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">More than a band, Myrath is a testament to how music born from struggle and identity can transcend borders and generations.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Shelf Lives is an Electro-Bass Punk band, which is definitely not a real genre. After a few years of creating, releasing and caring-ish what everyone thinks, they now don't (at all) but are obsessed with experimenting and embracing authentically whatever they feel. The objective is clear and the boundaries intentional; the point is to get every listener to feel something, whether it’s bad or good, whether they want to or not. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">On the face of it, Shelf Lives make catchy, energetic tunes that bring the abrasiveness and physicality of punk back to a small, cramped house party setting. It’s music so rowdy you can practically feel the sweat on the ceiling and the sound of crushed cans under your feet.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Though Shelf Lives haven’t been a band for long, they’ve already played acclaimed sets at Glastonbury, Boomtown, Kendall Calling, TGE, SXSW, New Colossus, 2000 Trees, YNOT and headlined the Rising Stage at Green Man, have supported the likes of Skunk Anansie, Lambrini Girls, Sprints, Panic Shack, Jehnny Beth, The Kills, Lynx and more. Joined fellow confrontational noise-makers Bob Vylan and HO99O9 on the cover of Gigwise, had a spread in NME and praise and features in Clash, DIY, UPSET, Dork, Line of Best Fit and on BBC R1 Jack Saunders, Jess Iszatt, Steve Lamacq and more.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Just when you think you’ve figured them out… they slip into the next phase with a grin and no intention of slowing down.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Artist Statement:</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><em>"We've made the decision to reschedule a couple of our shows Our London headline show is moving to October 8th and a new date for Dublin will be announced soon. Same energy. Different date!<br>All existing tickets remain valid for the new date. Refunds are available from point of purchase if needed."</em></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Legendary Southern California G-punk pioneers (Hed)p.e. were known for their raw, brutal honesty, raunchy lyrics, and often outlandish sense of humor. During their rise amid the nu-meal ranks, (Hed)p.e. shows often united fans and were a giant middle finger to the corporate rock that was ruling the airwaves in the late 90s and early 2000s. (Hed)p.e's defiant attitude, chaotic energy and groove is what people related to, as well as earned them the respect of fellow musicians like Jonathan Davis from Korn, M. Shadows from Avenged Sevenfold, and Chester Bennington from Linkin Park. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">(Hed) P.E are the pioneers of the G-Punk sound, which fuses together punk-rock, metal, hip-hop and reggae. The band has toured the world for 20 years sharing the stage with the likes of Suicidal Tendencies, System of a Down, KORN, Tech N9ne, Motley Crue as well as the original Black Sabbath on the iconic Ozzfest tour. (Hed) P.E experienced a creative resurgence after signing with Suburban Noize Records in the early 2000s and was instrumental in developing the booming underground scene. The band recently released a new album “DETOX” in December via Suburban Noize Records.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p></div>

</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="9dd7dce563357af9bf95" id="block-9dd7dce563357af9bf95"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small"><strong>Bird On The Wire presents ULRIKA SPACEK at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Ulrika Spacek is a British experimental rock band from London, known for their hypnotic blend of jagged guitar textures and dreamlike atmospherics. There’s a strange comfort in Ulrika Spacek’s dissonance, since emerging from the shadows of a creaking East London house known only as “KEN,” the band has quietly built a reputation for turning existential inertia into sound.Formed in 2014 by Rhys Edwards and Rhys Williams, Ulrika Spacek began as an insular project and has remained defiantly self-contained with the addition of Joseph Stone, Callum Brown, Syd Kemp and Rhys Jenkins.Debut album The Album Paranoia (2016) introduced listeners to a meticulously crafted world of off-kilter melodies and enveloping drones. It was followed by Modern English Decoration (2017), a critically acclaimed second LP that pushed their sound into more refined and textural territory. After a period of near-silence, they returned in 2024 with Compact Trauma, an album that channeled the anxiety and dislocation of the modern age through a prismatic haze of guitars, loops, and elliptical lyrics. The music lives in the liminal space between introspection and abrasion, the melodic and the abstract. With emphasis on sonic experimentation, visual art, and immersive live performances, the band make records the way people write journals: privately, obsessively, with a sense that they may go unread. And somehow, that makes them feel even more intimate. Fourth album ‘EXPO’ is due to be released early 2026.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Born Again Concerts presents BAEST with special guests DEADNATE &amp; SAWTICIDE live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">BAEST is a modern metal powerhouse from Denmark known for their explosive energy, genre-defying sound, and commanding live shows. Since their debut <em>Danse Macabre</em> (2018), the Aarhus-based quintet has released four acclaimed albums, including the 2025 breakthrough <em>Colossal</em>, which blends death metal aggression with classic rock and ‘80s heavy metal. BAEST has performed over 350 shows, touring with Arch Enemy, Fit For An Autopsy, Krisiun, Abbath, and Entombed AD, and appearing at Wacken, Bloodstock, and Copenhell. With millions of streams and awards including GAFFAs and Artist of the Year at Den Hårde Tone, BAEST is on a bold path to global impact.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Action! presents BRIDGE CITY SINNERS + special guest MISTER JOE BLACK live at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">From the misty, pine-covered hills of the Pacific Northwest hail the Bridge City Sinners. Dark Folk? Americana? Folk Punk?&nbsp;Pre-war era Jazz? Blackgrass? This string band bends the meaning of the word genre with their eclectic blend of styles, defying categorisation.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">They started their journey by busking on street corners across the country, and now this supergroup of musicians find themselves on the national tour circuit. But the Sinners still hold true to the DIY mentality by putting albums out on their self-made record label, Flail Records. With talented musicianship and a live show full of attitude, this is one band you don’t want to miss.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Sparta are back, with their all new, sixth album, ‘Cut a Silhouette’, and London headline show. Jim Ward has of course cut plenty of silhouettes, first as a vital member of pioneering post-hardcore outfit, At The Drive In, then as frontman of Sparta, as well as a handful of solo releases. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Now, in 2026, the band is completed by bassist Matt Miller and drummer, Neil Hennessy. They have made a record that’s a culmination of the perfectly imperfect chemistry that flows between them. ‘Cut a Silhouette’ is a collision of past &amp; present, that builds off their legacy, but equally continues their evolution. This is pure, unadulterated Sparta.&nbsp;<br></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Tropic Gold pull from metalcore, industrial noise, electronic production and modern alternative culture without ever sitting comfortably in one lane. Self-produced and creatively self-driven, the South East trio have built early momentum through a mix of huge hooks, abrasive electronics and the kind of volatility that makes their songs feel like they could completely fall apart at any second.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Support from BBC Radio 1, Kerrang! and Rock Sound has helped push the band well beyond underground buzz, while tours alongside WARGASM, Resolve, Windwaker and Normandie have quickly established them as a genuinely impressive live band rather than just another internet-heavy project.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The material following last year’s ‘<em>SICK TO DEATH OF EVERYTHING’</em> EP feels sharper, heavier and more immediate, leaning harder into contrast without losing the hooks underneath it all.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">With appearances at Download Festival and a stage headline slot at 2000trees Festival this summer, Tropic Gold are starting to feel less like a promising new act and more like a band properly breaking through.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><em>&nbsp;</em></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">With a clear vision, open heart, and guitar in hand, Paris Jackson plugs into pure emotion at the source. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">She’s not just playing a signature brand of alternative rock; she’s tracing a lasting mark in the shape of a beautiful scar that’s cut into the skin by her raw instrumentation and relatable lyrics. The Los Angeles-based vocalist, guitarist, songwriter, and consummate creative isn’t afraid to confront tragedy, trauma, or demons of any kind with a scream, a smirk, and a power chord. She creates the kind of music that can inspire you to take a look at yourself, change your perspective, or simply appreciate the messy magic of life in the moment.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">She introduced her artistry on 2020’s <em>wilted</em>—crafted with Manchester Orchestra’s Andy Hull and Robert McDowell. It vaulted to #1 on the iTunes Top Alternative Albums Chart and incited tastemaker applause from<em> Associated Press</em>,<em> Entertainment Weekly</em>,<em> NME</em>,<em> NPR</em>,<em> NYLON</em>,<em> Refinery29</em>, and <em>Rolling Stone. </em>On “lighthouse,” she teamed with producer Butch Walker and tapped Mike McCready of Pearl Jam for its guitar solo. She evolved into a formidable live performer by headlining packed houses and supporting Queens of The Stone Age, Incubus, Silversun Pickups, and The Revivalists.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">As a renaissance woman, she extended her creativity with roles in Lee Daniels’ <em>Star</em>, <em>American Horror Stories</em>, Prime Video’s <em>Swarm</em>,<em> Doctor Odyssey</em>,<em> Gringo</em>,<em> The Space Between, </em>and <em>One Spoon of Chocolate</em>. She remains an active ambassador for the Elizabeth Taylor AIDS Foundation and was honored with the Shining Star Award at the 35th Annual Friendly House Awards Luncheon. Born from a collision of sound, experience, and emotion, her second full-length offering, <em>HAPPIEST DAY OF MY LIFE</em> [Republic Records], is a burst of lingering light, energy, and feeling.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Born Again Concerts proudly presents ACRES ‘THE HOST UK/EU TOUR 2026’ with special guests WAYSIDE, WHAT LIES BELOW and LIFESPARK live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Acres process universal struggles, raw emotion, and life’s trials and tribulations through an unpredictable and undeniable hybrid of insurgently catchy melodies, neck-breaking grooves, and disarmingly seductive soundscapes. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Audiences initially fell under the UK band’s spell in 2019 when they unveiled the fan favorite <em>Lonely World</em>. After grinding on the road, they made significant strides with 2023’s <em>Burning Throne</em>. “My Everything” reeled in 2.6 million Spotify streams followed by “Hold On” with another 2 million Spotify streams.<em> KERRANG!</em> applauded how, <em>“Acres display their potential with some big choruses to match</em>,<em>” </em>and <em>WHEN THE HORN BLOWS</em> hailed <em>Burning Throne</em> as <em>“a classic metalcore album filled with swinging hooks, rough riffs, popping electronic elements and lovely vocals that turn into monster screams</em>.<em>”</em></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In 2025, the rapidly rising quartet—Ben Lumber, Alex Freeman, Jack Rogers, Ash Scott—rally around a spirit of sonic evolution on their third full-length album, <em>The Host</em> [Solid State]. Working with The Plot In You frontman Landon Tewers behind the board as producer, the band creatively level up as they deliver a caustic, catchy, and conceptual body of work primed to provoke thought and feeling in equal measure. This era begins with the single “Bloodlust” and much more to come.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small"><strong>Live Nation presents STVW live&nbsp;at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The German Songwriter/Producer &amp; DJ Steve Witzlsperger aka STVW is one of the fastest rising artists within the new generation of dance music known for his energetic, yet melodic and emotional dance sound combined with elements from Pop- Punk, Emo and Rock, called ‘PUNK RAVE’.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">His unique live performances with electric guitar undoubtedly make him the Rockstar of the dance music scene. He also created the special “PUNK RAVE (LIVE)” show with an additional drummer, which combines the feeling of a Rock concert with electronic sounds.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Through releases on the most influential imprints in the dance scene such as Spinnin Records, W&amp;W´ s label Rave Culture, Hardwell´ s Revealed Recordings, Warner Music or VirginEMI and successfully working with top tier artists such as Electric Callboy, Breathe</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Carolina, Timmy Trumpet, W&amp;W or pop-trio Cheat Codes he was able to amass multi-million streams across all streaming platforms to date. STVW also gained recognition in the Rock music scene with his ‚PUNK RAVE’ sound. Bands and artists like Simple Plan, blink-182, Machine Gun Kelly, Good Charlotte, or Boys Like Girls not only backed his vision but even gave their stamp of approval to electrifying ‘PUNK RAVE’ versions of some of their iconic hits.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">With his PUNK RAVE LIVE Tour, STVW has been bringing his high-energy show to iconic venues around the world. In 2025, he launched the concept’s first tour, immediately selling out shows across the UK, Australia, Canada, and Germany.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">In 2026, the tour expands significantly with new stops across Germany, the UK, Canada, Australia, Switzerland, Spain, France, and Austria, as well as additional headline shows in the US and Asia. The year will also feature a major summer festival run, including an appearance at Download Festival in the UK.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">STVW has built a dedicated and steadily growing international ‚PUNK RAVE’ fan base and proves he’s not afraid to be different than everybody else.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">With all the present international achievements and upcoming projects STVW is undoubtedly one of the most interesting crossover live acts Germany has to offer.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">For ten years Melbourne’sSpike Fuck has existed more as a messy myth than an artist – sporadic works forever poised on the precipice of triumph, rumours of death or insanity and so on. Spike’s foray into music in 2015 served a cultural fantasy, not by any overarching sense of ambition, but rather a would-be, cosplay pop star arrested by his own devices and whose melancholy wove through unlikely cultural circles. His sole body of work, <em>The Smackwave EP </em>(Partisan Records), addressed themes as literal as the title suggests: drug use, gender identity, religion and existentialism. Soon after its release, Spike was swept up in the whirlwind of unexpected success, moving from underground warehouse parties to being draped in high fashion and editorial photoshoots accompanied by interviews, in which he gave unrelenting and uncensored details of his life.&nbsp;</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">On the precipice of breakthrough, Spike disappeared. Bootleg uploads and comments on old YouTube videos discussed possibilities that seemed wild but believable, given Spike’s nature, fueling rumours of monastic solitude, relapse, or reinvention as a LinkedIn-worthy daytime professional. Only the most sincere have kept his myth alive.&nbsp;</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Crucified Barbara is an all-female Swedish hard rock and heavy metal band formed in Stockholm in 1998 . Initially rooted in punk, they quickly embraced a heavier sound, blending hard rock with metal and trash sensibilities. The quartet—Mia Coldheart (lead vocals,lead&nbsp; guitar), Klara Force (guitar), Ida Evileye (bass), and Nicki Wicked (drums)—released four acclaimed studio albums between 2005 and 2014: In Distortion We Trust, ’Til Death Do Us Party, The Midnight Chase, and In The Red .</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Despite widespread worldwide touring—including festival appearances and a stint in Melodifestivalen—they disbanded in 2016, citing burnout and a loss of joy in playing together&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">In a heartfelt turn, the original lineup announced a reunion in October 2024 to celebrate the 20th anniversary of their debut album, planning a comeback at Sweden Rock Festival in June 2025 . Vocalist Mia describes the reunion as feeling “like coming home” after reconnecting with her bandmates over a beer, rehearsing, and rediscovering their shared passion.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Their long-awaited return became a reality: on June 7, 2025, they performed their first show in over nine years at Sweden Rock Festival to an emotional reception. The reunion has continued with appearances at other festivals such as Resurrection Fest (Spain), La Guerre Du Son (France), and Skogsröjet (Sweden) and plans are in the making for 2026!</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">SHORELINE was formed in 2015 out of a desire to be an active part of the scene back home in Münster. First demo songs on YouTube and plenty of DIY diligence soon got the band on the road. With the EP ‘You Used To Be A Safe Place’ (Uncle M Music, 2018) and their debut album ‘Eat My Soul’ (Uncle M Music, 2019), they quickly grew beyond the status of an insider tip. The follow-up ‘Growth’ (End Hits Records, 2022) further develops the band's political side after the pandemic years, including songs about animal rights (Meat Free Youth) and anti-Asian racism (Konichiwa).</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">With their third album, ‘To Figure Out’, SHORELINE gained attention beyond Europe's borders when they became the first German band to release an album on the US label Pure Noise Records.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Comprising members of agit-punks Fat White Family and synth prog group Eccentronic Research Council, the Moonlandingz began life as a fictional band on the ERC's 2015 album, Johnny Rocket, Narcissist &amp; Music Machine...I'm Your Biggest Fan.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: justify; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">A tale of a female fan stalking her favorite singer, Johnny Rocket, of her favorite band, the outer space rockabilly Moonlandingz, the ERC needed someone to play the band, so they brought in Saul Adamczewski and Lias Saoudi of Fat White Family to help out. They recorded an EP to go along with the album and then, buoyed by the experience, everyone involved decided to take it one step further and make the Moonlandingz a real live band. The resulting album, Interplanetary Class Classics, was released in early 2017 on Chimera Music. They toured the U.K. and Europe, then released the This Cities Undone EP late in the year. Their last shows of 2017 were billed as possibly their last ever, as the bandmembers resolved to return to their regular gigs. Their record label wasn’t ready to say goodbye, however, and in early 2018 released a deluxe edition of Interplanetary Class Classics that came with a second disc of remixes, demos, and stray tracks.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: justify; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In 2025, they returned with a new album, No Rocket Required.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>The Talib Kweli show due to take place on Wednesday 19 August at The Dome London has been rescheduled to&nbsp;Monday 16 November 2026.&nbsp;All tickets already purchased will be valid for the new date. If you are unable to attend the new date, refunds will be available via your point of purchase.&nbsp;</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Brooklyn's Talib Kweli is revered for his insightful, intelligent lyrics and advanced technical skills on the mic. The earnest MC became one of the most critically successful rappers of his time, which dawned in the late '90s when he formed Reflection Eternal with DJ Hi-Tek and rapped alongside Mos Def as part of the group Black Star. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Their widely acclaimed 1998 album debut, Black Star, helped make Rawkus Records one of the premier underground rap outposts of the late '90s. Reflection Eternal's debut full-length, 2000's Train of Thought, preceded a prolific solo career, which included the gold-certified Quality (2002) and Eardrum (2007), which hit number two on the Billboard 200. Kweli released several albums and mixtapes through his company Blacksmith Music, then formed the independent Javotti Media in the early 2010s, releasing lower profile but acclaimed efforts like 2017's Radio Silence. He remained busy into the 2020s, with two podcasts as well as a collaboration with Diamond D called Gotham, and a 2023 joint effort with Madlib titled Liberation 2.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Gvllow blends the sonic and visual aesthetics of Punk Rock, Post Punk, 80s Goth, and subtle undertones of Rap to create a sound that is fresh, diverse, and completely unique.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Born and raised in the Inland Empire of Riverside, California, he grew up in the SoCal Punk scene and became involved in the burgeoning underground rap scene, DJing and producing for the likes of Ghostemane, JGRXXN, and Lil Peep, in the group known as Schemaposse. Since then, he has gone on to perform as a touring DJ for  City Morgue, as well as release two solo albums.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Gvllow has also been featured in the likes of Kerrang!, Revolver Magazine and Slipknot's media brand, <a href="http://Knotfest.com">Knotfest.com</a>.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">GVLLOW is still known to this day for being a hands-on, self-recording, and self-produced solo artist, along with graphic design that captures every aspect of his creative and artistic mindset through his music and imagery. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">With over 54 million streams on Spotify,130,000 monthly listeners, and 3.8 million YouTube views, GVLLOW's sonic evolution was set to further cement his status as an innovator, blending multiple genres into a sound that is both familiar and yet fresh.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">WesGhost exists at the intersection of emotion and energy, blending 2000s pop-punk, alternative, and hip-hop into a sound that feels both familiar and forward-moving. Masked by his signature balaclava, he strips away image to focus on connection—turning vulnerability into something loud, distorted, and shared.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">His projects DON’T WORRY, I’LL BE FINE (2024) and AM I DREAMING? With a co-sign from Blackbear, a Diplo collaboration on <em>“Psychward,”</em> and his latest single <em>“GASLIGHT”</em> pushing his sound even further, WesGhost continues to break genre rules while keeping his world rooted in honesty, intensity, and togetherness—with a world tour set to be announced soon.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><br></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The universe of Gong began in 1969 when Daevid Allen was inspired by a profound psychedelic vision. A founder member of Soft Machine, Allen incorporated his spiritual and metaphysical leanings into an evolving collective, more a mythology than a band in the conventional sense.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The current incarnation, who were put together by Daevid before his swansong album with Gong, ‘I See You’, honour his intention that Gong do not die with him, urging the band to “carry it on into new unknown heights and depths far beyond anything I could ever imagine myself”.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The collective is the most stable in Gong’s illustrious history, having written, recorded and toured together for eleven years since Allen’s passing. A dynamic, powerful and explosive live band, their music draws from the credo of the original Gong while remaining committed to pushing the composition, performances and message into new realms, paying no mind to nostalgia. Gong in 2026 continue the ethics, attitude and lifestyle that was always woven into the fabric of the band.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>XENTRIX</strong> were called SWEET VENGEANCE from 1984 to 1988.&nbsp;The original lineup consisted of vocalist/rhythm guitarist Chris Astley, guitarist Kristian Havard, bassist Paul MacKenzie, and drummer Dennis Gasser. The band attracted attention with a five-star rating from&nbsp;Kerrang!&nbsp;magazine, and&nbsp;Roadrunner_Records&nbsp;then contacted the band asking them why they had not been sent a copy and arranged an audition with the band. After the audition, the band were signed to the label and recorded their first album&nbsp;Shattered Existence&nbsp;in the summer of 1989. The band toured with SABBAT&nbsp;in support of the album. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In a June 2019 interview with Metal Crypt, guitarist Havard revealed that XENTRIX had already begun writing the follow-up to&nbsp;Bury the Pain.&nbsp;By March 2021, the band had written and demoed at least twelve songs for their new album and announced that August they were in the studio recording it. The album was completed in June 2022, Seven Words&nbsp;peaked at No. 39 on the UK Rock &amp; Metal Albums Chart.&nbsp;In order to promote&nbsp;Seven Words, XENTRIX (along with&nbsp;WHIPLASH and&nbsp;ARTILLERY) supported&nbsp;Vio-lence&nbsp;on their European&nbsp;MTV Headbangers Ball Tour. Astley rejoined by filling in for Walsh on the tour as Walsh was awaiting the birth of his second child in November 2022. XENTRIX renewed their deal with Listenable Records in November 2023 and the band are expected to release a new album this year.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">America indie-rock trio, CHEEKFACE, celebrate the release of their all new album, ‘Podium’ - out TODAY - with a return to London this fall for the first time since their sell out UK tour of 2025.&nbsp;</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Cheekface are influenced by the great American talk-singers like Lou Reed, Jonathan Richman and Stephen Malkmus, British post-punk bands like Wire and The Fall and proto-indie bands like The dB’s and Minutemen. The trio chart their own course with their openhearted lyrics set against the backdrop of our chaotic world. To know Cheekface is to love Cheekface. So get involved.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Joining them is the exvangelical folk-punk sounds of US singer-songwriter, Emperor X, and the electrifying Playboy Manbaby, for a triple-bill of fresh and exciting alt, indie and punk fuelled fun.<br></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">I DONT KNOW HOW BUT THEY FOUND ME (iDKHOW) is the professional moniker of singer/songwriter Dallon Weekes. Formerly a contributing creative member and bassist for Panic! at the Disco, He also fronted Salt Lake City cult favorite indie band The Brobecks, where he honed his signature blend of retro-inspired alt rock and witty, introspective lyricism. As a multi-instrumentalist and producer, Weekes draws from a variety of influences, blending elements of 70s new wave, glam, 90s Brit-pop, and indie garage rock into his music. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">iDKHOW formed secretly in 2016, and quickly gained a cult following despite Weekes spending it’s first year denying the project even existed. With his theatrical aesthetics, infectiously sharp songwriting and charismatic stage presence, iDKHOW has earned not only a Certified Gold Record with the independently produced “Choke”, but has also received critical acclaim, as well as commercial success solidifying Weekes’ place in the alternative music scene and beyond.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Bad Vibrations Presents PIGEON plus support live at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Cosmic exploration. Spiritual transformation. Unbridled spontaneity.&nbsp;These are the guiding principles of Pigeon, a psychedelic five-piece rooted in the English seaside town of Margate, yet making music that&nbsp;transcends borders. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Their debut album, OUTTANATIONAL, is a thrilling collection of party songs without limits: think William Onyeabor in outer-space or early Hot Chip making motorik afrobeat in a 70s New York loft. Building on a string of acclaimed EPs that have been playlisted on 6Music and led to coveted live slots at UK festivals like Glastonbury, Pigeon have evolved out of Afro-disco territory into something moodier.&nbsp;It’s an expansive record laced with heady krautrock, post-punk and punk-funk, indebted to the power of the groove and questing to find the meaning of home. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Pigeon must fly.&nbsp;</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Academy Events presents <strong>MENTAL CRUELTY </strong>plus supports <strong>OV SULFUR, EXTERMINATION DISMEMBERMENT, SUNEATER </strong>live Downstairs at The Dome</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Founded in 2016, the band played their way through locations in Europe, North America and Germany, and with four releases so far, they made their path into the international metal scene. Working with US Producer Josh Schroeder (Lorna Shore, The Browning, The Plot in You) on their last Album “A Hill To Die Upon” (2019, Unique Leader Records) they created a well-received and long lasting piece of brutality for their fans.&nbsp;</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Fast forward in 2022 their new vocalist Lukas Nicolai joined the ensemble for a new era with demonically vicious pipes. With a new frontman and new upcoming album ”ZWIELICHT” (2023, Century Media; produced by Josh Schroeder) they're off to new shores. This time combining the best of Deathcore and Black Metal for a match made in heaven. Emotional riffs, heavy “back to the roots” breakdowns and epic orchestral arrangements forming the fundament across genres for this LP.&nbsp;</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The guys took clear actions and now fully commit to this new beginning continuing their tireless pace set in their last releases. Risen out of the ashes they cement their name as a permanent instance of the German metal scene and have since been able to keep up with well-known bands of their genres. Their goal is to deliver uncompromising live performances with outstanding vocals and precise instrumental work. Mental Cruelty has created a formative function in social media as well as in the metal community and plans to continue its course.</p></div>

</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="97048ad388f2b4223d53" id="block-97048ad388f2b4223d53"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">I DONT KNOW HOW BUT THEY FOUND ME (iDKHOW) is the professional moniker of singer/songwriter Dallon Weekes. Formerly a contributing creative member and bassist for Panic! at the Disco, He also fronted Salt Lake City cult favorite indie band The Brobecks, where he honed his signature blend of retro-inspired alt rock and witty, introspective lyricism. As a multi-instrumentalist and producer, Weekes draws from a variety of influences, blending elements of 70s new wave, glam, 90s Brit-pop, and indie garage rock into his music. </p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">iDKHOW formed secretly in 2016, and quickly gained a cult following despite Weekes spending it’s first year denying the project even existed. With his theatrical aesthetics, infectiously sharp songwriting and charismatic stage presence, iDKHOW has earned not only a Certified Gold Record with the independently produced “Choke”, but has also received critical acclaim, as well as commercial success solidifying Weekes’ place in the alternative music scene and beyond.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>The Pad Presents &amp; Friends introduce SKIDS/ THEATRE OF HATE - Co Headline Tour plus supports live at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Two era defining artists <strong>SKIDS &amp; THEATRE OF HATE</strong> come together this autumn for an explosive UK co-headline tour.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>The Skids</strong> formed in 1977 in their hometown of Dunfermline, Scotland by Richard Jobson, Stuart Adamson, Bill Simpson &amp; Tom Kellichan. After releasing an independent single the band was played by John Peel, supported The Clash in concert and then were signed to Virgin Records in 1978. Their first singles were “Sweet Surburbia”, “The Saints are Coming” and “Into the Valley” – the latter reaching the UK Top Ten in early 1979.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Their seminal debut album “Scared to Dance” came out in 1979 which was quickly followed by two chart singles – “Masquerade” and “Working for the Yankee Dollar”. Both singles were taken from the Bill Nelson produced second album “Days in Europa”. The album also featured new member Rusty Egan of Rich Kids &amp; Visage fame after the departure of Tom Kellichan. The band released two more albums “The Absolute Game” (1980) and “Joy” (1981) before splitting.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The current Skids line up sees the lineup stripped back to an explosive 4 piece with Richard Jobson, Peter Byrchmore (Membranes), Hernandez (Drums) &amp; Connor Whyte (Guitar).</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Born Again Concerts proudly presents THE FELL Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Fusing soaring vocals, elite musicianship, and massive, modern rock production, THE FELL deliver hard-hitting, emotionally charged anthems that connect with fans across generations. Their sound is both cinematic and immediate, anchored in timeless rock energy but elevated by contemporary edge and sonic depth.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The band hit the ground running in 2025, releasing singles "Killswitch," "Face Out," and "Trippin'" ahead of their debut Killswitch EP: five tracks of hard rock heft. Their most recent single is "Footprints," a track with a storied history, its video originally filmed years ago in a WWII-era underground bunker in Warsaw, Poland, and recently completed with new footage.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Not resting on their laurels, with new material on the way and a slate of high-quality music videos ready for release, THE FELL are poised to make a serious mark on the global rock scene. Their upcoming music blends high-octane energy, lyrical depth, and commercial polish designed for arenas, airwaves, and everything in between.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Fans will get their next taste via forthcoming new single "The Way I Love You." The band have kept their cards close to their chest on the track so far, bar revealing its release is set for September 14th via their label Noise Nation Records / BCMG Recordings Inc., distributed worldwide by The Orchard.</p><p style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">While fans wait, whether headlining festivals or supporting major tours, THE FELL bring a next-level live show built on chemistry, credibility, and true musical excellence.</p></div>

</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="1871e238843b9cefba0a" id="block-1871e238843b9cefba0a"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Academy Events presents HALF ME plus supports live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Formed in Hamburg, Germany, Half Me have spent the last two years relentlessly taking their sound across the world, carving out a reputation as one of heavy music’s most distinctive emerging voices. Blending crushing intensity with an unsettling emotional weight, the band occupies a space where discomfort and honesty become inseparable.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">While working on their second full-length album, Half Me are stepping beyond the monochrome world that defined their previous era. The new material does not seek refuge in shadows, it drags everything into the harsh light instead. It is a confrontation with reality at its most exposed — uncomfortable, unfiltered, and impossible to ignore.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Heavy, dynamic, and unmistakably their own, the band continue to refine a sound that feels both violent and vulnerable.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">With new music arriving throughout the year and another extensive touring cycle ahead, Half Me are preparing to bring their next chapter to audiences worldwide. Uncomfortable, but true.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: start; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></div>

</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/31b4e3a9-f074-411d-ae8f-0cd820aa59c6_811/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="0e5c349f10c63fcf8cdf" id="block-0e5c349f10c63fcf8cdf"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Old Empire proudly present WARNING plus special guests TBA live at The Dome</strong></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">As Warning release their first new music in twenty years, Patrick Walker is self-effacing about what led to this moment. Over the last two decades, he has continued to write and release music; his attention was diverted to 40 Watt Sun, satisfied that he had achieved what he had set out to do with Warning. But in those intervening years, interest in Warning has swelled, organically gathering an ardent fanbase.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"> In particular, the 2006 album, Watching from a Distance, has gained a cult following. After a successful string of shows playing the album in 2017, Patrick knew he had a solid live band on hand but did not feel the call to write new Warning material.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In response to a transformative period in his life, Patrick turned towards writing new songs, and it soon became apparent that these belonged to Warning. In early January 2025, he started with a completely blank canvas, and piece by piece, day by day he started to fill it with ideas that evolved to become the songs that make up Rituals of Shame. He worked on the material all day, seven days a week, over three months, his immersion in the project becoming a full-time pursuit.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">In the slivers of time in between writing, a deal with Relapse was struck to release the album, which gave Patrick further impetus to complete the task in hand. Recording took place at The Arch Studio, a 140-year-old former church in Southport, UK, with recording and mixing handled by Chris Fullard (Idles, Sunn O))), Ulver). Having already worked with Chris on two 40 Watt Sun records, Patrick had developed an appreciation for his way of working: providing a light touch of structure to the process, allowing the songs to unfold as Patrick intended.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Lifelong musical inspirations of Patrick’s can be traced through Rituals of Shame, although they may at first be hard to identify. The ambitious structural arrangements harken to Marillion’s complex but soaring episodic songs. They retain a sparsity that is reminiscent of June Tabor’s economic arrangements; thick with melody but with a diaphanous air to them. Citing John Brenner of Revelation as an enduring inspiration, Patrick credits him with introducing the idea of how to infuse heavy music with significant emotional depth.</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Often reluctant to be drawn on the minutiae of his lyrics, Patrick does acknowledge that making this album was a direct response to the very present period of his life, its concerns being immediate. Rituals of Shame also echoes the enduring themes and fixations that have marked most of his work: guilt, shame, personal failure, obsession, longing, and separation, but, most of all, he says, love.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Live Nation presents The Black Dahlia Murder Two Decades of Nocturnal: Europe MMXXVII plus special guests live at The Dome</strong></p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Formed in Waterford, Michigan in 2001, The Black Dahlia Murder are one of the most critically acclaimed and enduring bands in American extreme metal. Signed to Metal Blade Records since their debut full-length Unhallowed (2003), the band has released ten studio albums — eight of which charted on the US Billboard 200, with 2011's Ritual peaking at No. 31 — and built a fiercely devoted global fanbase through relentless touring and an unwavering commitment to their craft. Multiple Summer Slaughter Tour headlining slots, appearances at Wacken Open Air, Graspop Metal Meeting, Louder Than Life, Ozzfest, and Warped Tour, and recognition including Metal Hammer's Golden Gods Award for Best Underground Band have marked a career defined by consistency, passion, and artistic growth. Their tenth album, Servitude (September 2024), marks a powerful new era led by co-founder Brian Eschbach, who stepped into the vocalist role following the passing of beloved co-founder Trevor Strnad in 2022. With acclaimed guitarist Wes Hauch — who joined initially as a live fill-in following Brandon Ellis' departure in early 2025 and has since become a full member — now firmly in the fold,</p><p style="white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The Black Dahlia Murder continue to build on a legacy that remains as vital and uncompromising as ever.</p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="sqsrte-small"><strong>Action! presents THE LAST INTERNATIONALE plus special guests live Downstairs at The Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The Last Internationale, also known as TLI, is a NY band formed by singer Delila Paz and guitarist Edgey. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Especially known for their powerful live performances, TLI has shared the stage with acts such as Robert Plant, Neil Young, The Who, Kings of Leon, Slash, Scott Weiland, Weezer, One Republic, Tom Morello, Lenny Kravitz, Incubus, Royal Blood, The Cult, Rival Sons, KISS, Deep Purple, opened for Guns and Roses AND played most of the major festivals throughout Europe, including Pink Pop, Rock Werchter, Hellfest, Mad Cool, Lollapalooza, and Hyde Park.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Their debut album, We Will Reign, was released on Epic Records in 2014.   <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="text-align: center; ; white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"><strong>Born Again Concerts&nbsp;proudly present ARNOCORPS - The 20th Anniversary of the First Summer Blockbuster UK Tour live Downstairs at the Dome</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">ACTION, ADVENTURE, HARDCORE, ROCK ‘N’ ROLL! LIVE! </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Commemorating the 20th anniversary of their inaugural UK Tour and the 2006 international release of their LP "The Greatest Band of All Time,” the last action rock heroes of ArnoCorps finally return! Limited full-blown live audio assaults have been scheduled throughout the United Kingdom. Performing their hits: Total Recall, Predator, and I’m Ballsy! </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">FANCY DRESS ENCOURAGED! </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">Although known for hurling volunteer audience members record distances and crowdsurfing on top of their guitar cases in displays of superhuman athleticism, there is no need to fear ArnoCorps‘ explosive performances; they are a rescue team, not assassins. The spectacle extends beyond the stage as attendees of ArnoCorps’ fabled live audio assaults are frequently adorned in camouflage face paint and uniforms that rival the adventure-ready appearance of the band themselves. A welcoming and inclusive atmosphere greets newcomers amidst a frenzy of bonding and unity under the ArnoCorps banner of ballsy defiance. Experiencing “the pump” is inevitable through crowd participation, including on-stage callisthenics challenges and impromptu bodybuilding posedown competitions.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true">The 2026 Summer Blockbuster UK Anniversary Tour coincides with ArnoCorps' latest release "BIG NOODLE ENERGY" on Jello Biafra’s legendary Alternative Tentacles Records. The new songs expose the shameless appropriation of ballsy alpine culture used to advertise noodles and energy drinks on Japanese television in the 80s and 90s. Yosh!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;" data-rte-preserve-empty="true"></p></div>

  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Los Angeles psych-punk shapeshifters Frankie and the Witch Fingers have spent the last decade mutating their sound into bold, electrifying new forms. </p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Their latest release, Trash Classic (via Greenway Records and The Reverberation Appreciation Society), plunges into a sewer-slick fusion of proto-punk venom, fractured new wave, and industrial grime.   <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>The Boston Arms &amp; Phoenix Rockabilly Clubs are uniting for one Unforgettable Saturday Night</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">In a move that will get the scene buzzin' the legendary Boston Arms Rockabilly Club and the Superb Phoenix Rockabilly Club are joining forces for one very special Saturday night.&nbsp;This rare collaboration promises a no-holds-barred onslaught of Rockabilly, Rock &amp; Roll and Rockin' Blues — the kind of event that will be talked about long after the last tune has faded out.&nbsp;</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>A Meeting of Icons</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The Boston Arms Rockabilly Club has long been one of the original stomping grounds of the UK’s rockabilly scene, known for its authenticity, atmosphere, history and a loyal crowd. The Phoenix Rockabilly Club, meanwhile, has built its reputation on strong events, fresh DJs, and a magical knack for keeping the dance floor alive. Together, they represent two distinct but complementary sides of the same coin.</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>What to Expect</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">This special night will feature the DJs from each club, each bringing their own unique twist to the event.&nbsp;Mark Greenaway, Timbo Slim, Little Carl and Dave Crozier. Spinning those raw driving rhythms from Hick Bop to Bo Diddley. Expect the dance floor to be packed with familiar faces and the unmistakable energy of a crowd united by the love for the music and the venue.&nbsp;For regulars of either club, it’s a chance to see old friends in the legendary setting of the Boston Dome&nbsp; If you're newer to the scene this would be a great opportunity to soak up some history and dig some boptastic tunes on rock n roll hallowed ground !&nbsp;</p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Why It Matters</strong></p><p class="sqsrte-small" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Collaborations like this are pretty rare, and they remind us of the power of great music to bring people together. By combining their strengths, the Boston Arms and Phoenix Rockabilly clubs are not just hosting a night out — they’re creating a moment in our history. When the lights dim and the first notes ring out, it won’t just be another Saturday night. It will be a celebration of everything that makes rockabilly more than just a genre — it’s our way of life!</p></div>
